_doc: AWBW COs by AWBW CO id. stars are [COP, SCOP] power-meter stars (from co_max_power / co_max_spower in replay snapshots); null means no such power. d2d holds the day-to-day modifiers; cop and scop start from d2d and replace any key they set, so a power that keeps a d2d penalty restates it. Every CO also gets +10% attack and defense while a power is on, and each owned comtower gives +10% attack (tower_atk); the engine adds those, so they are not listed. mods entries apply atk/def (%), move and range to the units an entry selects (see rules/__init__.py for selectors). luck is [good, bad]: the attacker adds a roll in 0..good and subtracts one in 0..bad. weather_as maps a weather to the one the CO's units move in (Olaf, Drake). terrain_atk is extra attack % by the attacker's terrain kind (replays show Koal's road bonus excludes bridges and Jake's plains bonus includes pipe rubble). notes quote awbw.amarriner.com/co.php (2026-10-12); effects not expressible as modifiers are implemented in the engine by CO id.

notes.d2d: No day-to-day abilities.
notes.cop: Hyper Repair -- All units gain +2 HP.
notes.scop: Hyper Upgrade -- All units gain +5 HP, +10% attack, and +1 movement.

notes.d2d: Indirect units have +1 range and gain +20% attack. Direct units (except footsoldiers) lose -20% attack.
notes.cop: Snipe Attack -- Indirect units gain +1 range and their attack is increased to +40%.
notes.scop: Super Snipe -- Indirect units gain +2 range and their attack is increased to +40%.

notes.d2d: Units cost +20% more to build, but gain +30% attack and defense.
notes.cop: Morale Boost -- All units' attack is increased to +40%.
notes.scop: Samurai Spirit -- All units' attack is increased to +40% and defense to +50%. Counterattacks do 1.5x more damage.

notes.d2d: Naval units gain +1 movement and +10 defense. Air units lose -30% attack. Unaffected by rain (except vision), and has a higher chance of Rain in random weather.
notes.cop: Tsunami -- All enemy units lose 1 HP (to a minimum of 0.1 HP) and half their fuel.
notes.scop: Typhoon -- All enemy units lose 2 HP (to a minimum of 0.1 HP) and half their fuel. Weather changes to rain for 1 day.

notes.d2d: Direct units (except footsoldiers) gain +20% attack. Indirect units lose -10% attack and have -1 range.
notes.cop: Max Force -- Direct units (except footsoldiers) gain +1 movement and their attack increases to +30%.
notes.scop: Max Blast -- Direct units (except footsoldiers) gain +2 movement and their attack increases to +50%.

notes.d2d: Footsoldiers gain +30% attack and a 50% capture point bonus (rounded down). Other direct units lose -10% attack. Transports gain +1 movement.
notes.cop: Double Time -- Footsoldiers gain +1 movement and their attack is increased to +50%.
notes.scop: Victory March -- Footsoldiers gain +2 movement and their attack is increased to +70%. Footsoldiers capture buildings instantly, regardless of their HP.

notes.d2d: Unaffected by snow, but rain affects him the same as snow would for others.
notes.cop: Blizzard -- Changes the weather to Snow for 1 day.
notes.scop: Winter Fury -- Enemy units lose 2 HP (to a minimum of 0.1 HP), and the weather changes to snow for 1 day.

notes.d2d: Air units gain +15% attack and +10% defense, and consume -2 fuel per day. Naval units lose -30% attack.
notes.cop: Lightning Drive -- Air units attack and defense are increased to +20%.
notes.scop: Lightning Strike -- Air units attack and defense are increased to +20%. All non-footsoldier units may move and fire again, even if built this turn (use this power after moving!).

notes.d2d: No day-to-day abilities.
notes.cop: Sideslip -- All units gain +1 movement.
notes.scop: Sidewinder -- All units gain +2 movement.

notes.d2d: Units gain +10% attack.
notes.cop: Black Wave -- All units gain +1 HP, and all enemy units lose -1 HP (to a minimum of 0.1 HP).
notes.scop: Black Storm -- All units gain +2 HP, and all enemy units lose -2 HP (to a minimum of 0.1 HP).

notes.d2d: Copters gain +50% attack, footsoldiers gain +40% attack, but all other non-air units lose -10% attack. Transports gain +1 movement.
notes.cop: Copter Command -- Copters' attack is increased to +65%. 9 HP unwaited infantry are placed on every owned, empty city.
notes.scop: Airborne Assault -- Copters' attack is increased to +65%. 9 HP unwaited mechs are placed on every owned, empty city.

notes.d2d: Vehicles gain +10% attack, but all other units (including footsoldiers) lose -10% attack.
notes.cop: Turbo Charge -- Vehicles gain +1 movement and their attack is increased to +20%. All units resupply fuel and ammo.
notes.scop: Overdrive -- Vehicles gain +2 movement and their attack is increased to +40%. All units resupply fuel and ammo.

notes.d2d: Unit cost is reduced to 80% (20% cheaper), but lose -10% attack.
notes.cop: Gold Rush -- Funds are multiplied by 1.5x.
notes.scop: Power of Money -- Unit attack percentage increases by (3 * Funds / 1000)%.

notes.d2d: Units gain +10% attack for every terrain star (note: air units are unaffected by terrain).
notes.cop: Terrain Tactics -- Movement cost for all terrain is reduced to 1, except in Snow.
notes.scop: Prime Tactics -- Terrain stars are doubled (attack and defense). Movement cost over all terrain is reduced to 1, except in Snow.

notes.d2d: Units cost is reduced to 90% (10% cheaper).
notes.cop: Barter -- Units cost is reduced to 50%.
notes.scop: Merchant Union -- Units cost reduced to 50%, and ground units can deploy from cities.

notes.d2d: Units gain +1 vision in Fog of War, have hidden HP, and counterattacks do 1.5x more damage. Luck is reduced to -9% to +9%.
notes.cop: Enhanced Vision -- All units gain +1 vision, and can see into forests and reefs.
notes.scop: Counter Break -- All units gain +1 vision, and can see into forests and reefs. A unit being attacked will attack first (even if it would be destroyed by the attack).

notes.d2d: Receives +100 funds per property that grants funds and she owns. (Note: labs, comtowers, and 0 Funds games do not get additional income).
notes.cop: Market Crash -- Reduces enemy power bar(s) by (10 * Funds / 5000)% of their maximum power bar.
notes.scop: War Bonds -- Receives funds equal to 50% of the damage dealt when attacking enemy units.

notes.d2d: Units gain +30% attack, but lose -20% defense.
notes.cop: Knuckleduster -- All units' attack is increased to +50%.
notes.scop: Haymaker -- All units' attack is increased to +80%.

notes.d2d: Units (even air units) gain +10% attack power on roads.
notes.cop: Forced March -- All units gain +1 movement, and the road bonus is increased to +20%.
notes.scop: Trail of Woe -- All units gain +2 movement, and the road bonus is increased to +30%.

notes.d2d: Units (even air units) gain +10% attack power on plains.
notes.cop: Beat Down -- Land indirects gain +1 range, and plains bonus is increased to +20%.
notes.scop: Block Rock -- Land indirects gain +1 range, plains bonus is increased to +40%, and vehicles gain +2 movement.

notes.d2d: Units (even air units) gain +40% attack while on urban terrain. HQs, bases, airports, ports, cities, labs, and comtowers count as urban terrain.
notes.cop: Urban Blight -- All enemy units lose -3 HP on urban terrain. Urban bonus is increased to +80%.
notes.scop: High Society -- Urban bonus is increased to +130%, and attack for all units is increased by +3% for each of your owned urban terrain.

notes.d2d: Luck on attacks is +0 to +19%.
notes.cop: Lucky Star -- Luck is improved to +0% to +59%.
notes.scop: Lady Luck -- Luck is improved to +0% to +99%.

notes.d2d: Luck on attacks is -9% to +24%.
notes.cop: Brute Force -- Luck range is changed to -19% to +49%.
notes.scop: Barbaric Blow -- Luck range is changed to -39% to +89%.

notes.d2d: Luck on attacks is -14% to +29%.
notes.cop: Overclock -- Luck range is changed to -24% to +54%.
notes.scop: System Crash -- Luck range is changed to -44% to +94%.

notes.d2d: Units gain +20% defense against indirect units. Each comtower grants all units an additional +10% defense.
notes.cop: Tower Shield -- Indirect defense is increased to +40%. Comtower bonuses are doubled.
notes.scop: Tower of Power -- Indirect defense is increased to +80%. Comtower bonuses are tripled.

notes.d2d: Units repair +1 additional HP (note: liable for costs).
notes.cop: Lucky Lass -- Luck is improved to +0% to +39%.
notes.scop: Covering Fire -- Three 2-range missiles deal 3 HP damage each. The missiles target the opponents' greatest accumulation of footsoldier HP, unit value, and unit HP (in that order).

notes.d2d: Movement cost over all terrain is reduced to 1, except in Snow. Units lose -20% attack and gain +20% defense.
notes.cop: Meteor Strike -- A 2-range missile deals 4 HP damage. The missile targets an enemy unit located at the greatest accumulation of unit value.
notes.scop: Meteor Strike II -- A 2-range missile deals 8 HP damage. The missile targets an enemy unit located at the greatest accumulation of unit value.

notes.d2d: Units gain +10% attack and +10% defense.
notes.scop: Ex Machina -- A 2-range missile deals 3 HP damage and prevents all affected units from acting next turn. The missile targets the opponents' greatest accumulation of unit value.
